xml/node#

XML trees: elements, text, comments and processing instructions.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let feed = ParsedXml(text).document().root();
feed.attribute("version");
for feed.children("item") -> item { item.text("title"); }
XmlDocument(XmlElement(XmlName("note"), [XmlText("hi")])).xml();

object XmlElement#

object XmlElement does XmlNode

An element keeps its attributes and children as given, checked for limits and name conflicts when made. Its text and depth are computed on the first question, and a tree that is too deep or too large is refused then.
